data.summary: As your Shooting phase begins, pick 1 enemy unit **visible** to and 30" or less from this unit's Master of Ordnance model, not yet picked by this ability in this phase. Until the phase ends, Blast weapons of friendly **ASTRA MILITARUM ARTILLERY** models have **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)** against that unit.
